high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "ramayana_mahabharta." The post includes a yellow background with black text and images related to the Ramayana, a Hindu epic. The text at the top reads: "Valmiki Ramayan, sundar kaand (4.27.12) say's, Hanuman when entered in Lanka, he sees Rakshasha and four tusked elephants guarding the palaces of Ravan." Below this, there are two images: On the left, there is an illustration of a gomphoth
